## Academic and Research Projects

This section presents selected academic and research projects related to biomedical engineering, embedded systems, and artificial intelligence.

## TinyML ECG Classification

Development of a lightweight deep-learning model for ECG beat classification and deployment on embedded devices.

Main topics:

- ECG signal processing
- Deep learning
- TinyML
- Model quantization
- Embedded AI
- ESP32-S3 deployment

## Embedded ECG Monitoring

Development and validation of an embedded IoT framework for ECG signal processing and monitoring.

Main topics:

- ECG acquisition
- Digital signal processing
- R-peak detection
- Embedded systems
- Internet of Things
- Real-time monitoring

## Biomedical Instrumentation

Development of intelligent biomedical instrumentation combining sensors, signal acquisition, embedded processing, and artificial intelligence.
